map.正常形态(%) = 正常形态数 / 计数总数 × 100: Normal morphology (%) = normal morphology count / total counted × 100

map.WHO 第 5/6 版严格标准正常形态≥4% 为参考下限（Tygerberg 法: Under the strict criteria of WHO 5th/6th editions, normal morphology ≥4% is the reference lower bound (Tygerberg method).
